223        sampling kernel, and loads model weights and adapters.
224
225        Args:
226            pipeline_config: Configuration for the pipeline and runtime behavior.
227            pipeline_model: Concrete model implementation to use for execution.
228            weight_adapters: Mapping from weights format to adapter implementation.
229            tokenizer: Tokenizer implementation used to build contexts and decode.
230            memory_plan: Memory plan from the registry containing max_batch_size
231                and other resolved memory parameters.
232
233        Raises:
234            ValueError: If ``quantization_encoding`` is not configured in
235                ``pipeline_config.model`` or if structured output is
236                requested without a valid tokenizer delegate.
237        """
238        self._pipeline_config = pipeline_config
239        self._max_batch_size = memory_plan.planned_max_batch_size
240        max_batch_size = memory_plan.planned_max_batch_size
241        model_config: MAXModelConfig = pipeline_config.model
242        huggingface_config = model_config.huggingface_config
243        if huggingface_config is None:
244            raise ValueError(
245                f"Text generation pipeline requires a HuggingFace config for '{model_config.model_path}', "
246                "but config could not be loaded. "
247                "Please ensure the model repository contains a valid config.json file."
248            )
249
250        self._devices = load_devices(list(memory_plan.require_device_specs()))
251        self._tokenizer = tokenizer
252
253        self.batch_info_output_fname = environ.get(
254            "MAX_BATCH_INFO_FILENAME", None
255        )
256        self.batch_infos: list[BatchInfo] = []
257
258        # Initialize structured output helper for constrained decoding.
259        # The helper's ``enable_response_format_schema`` mirrors the user
260        # flag and gates user-supplied JSON schemas; the bitmask-in-the-graph
261        # decisions below are gated separately on
262        # ``pipeline_config.needs_bitmask_constraints``.
263        # structured_output_backend is None only on an unresolved config;
264        # from_tokenizer falls back to "xgrammar" in that case.
265        self._structured_output = StructuredOutputHelper.from_tokenizer(
266            self.tokenizer,
267            pipeline_config.sampling.enable_structured_output,
268            pipeline_config.runtime.tool_parser,
269            pipeline_config.sampling.structured_output_backend,
270            pipeline_config.sampling.structured_output_any_whitespace,
271        )
272        self.vocab_size = self._structured_output.vocab_size
273
274        # Initialize Session.
275        session = InferenceSession(
276            devices=[*self._devices],
277            precompiled_mefs=pipeline_config.runtime.precompiled_mefs,
278            export_mefs=pipeline_config.runtime.export_mefs,
279        )
280        self.session = session
281        self._label_scorer = BatchLabelScorer(
282            session,
283            self._devices[0],
284            pipeline_config.sampling.in_dtype,
285            self.vocab_size,
286        )
287
288        # Configure session with pipeline settings.
289        self._pipeline_config.configure_session(session)
290
291        # Load model.
292        # Retrieve the weights repo id (falls back to model_path when unset).
293        weight_paths: list[Path] = model_config.resolved_weight_paths()
294
295        if not issubclass(pipeline_model, PipelineModelWithKVCache):
296            raise ValueError(
297                f"TextGenerationPipeline requires a model with KV cache support, found {pipeline_model.__name__}"
298            )
299        self._request_validator = eager_usage_validator(
300            pipeline_config.runtime.eager_usage_validator, "execution"
301        )
302        with eager_usage_validator(
303            pipeline_config.runtime.eager_usage_validator, "initialization"
304        ):
305            self._pipeline_model = pipeline_model(
306                pipeline_config=self._pipeline_config,
307                session=session,
308                devices=self._devices,
309                kv_cache_config=model_config.kv_cache,
310                weights=load_weights(weight_paths),
311                adapter=weight_adapters.get(weights_format(weight_paths)),
312                return_logits=ReturnLogits.ALL
313                if self._pipeline_config.model.enable_echo
314                else ReturnLogits.LAST_TOKEN,
315                max_batch_size=max_batch_size,
316                memory_plan=memory_plan,
317            )
318
319        available_cache_memory = memory_plan.available_cache_memory
320        kv_params = self._pipeline_model.kv_params
321        self._kv_manager = load_kv_manager(
322            params=kv_params,
323            max_batch_size=max_batch_size,
324            max_seq_len=self._pipeline_model.max_seq_len,
325            session=session,
326            available_cache_memory=available_cache_memory,
327            is_di_enabled=pipeline_config.runtime.is_disaggregated,
328            model_name=pipeline_config.model.model_name,
329            max_num_input_tokens=pipeline_config.runtime.max_num_input_tokens,
330        )
331
332        self._encoder_cache: VisionEncoderCache[TextAndVisionContext] | None = (
333            None
334        )
335        if isinstance(self._pipeline_model, SupportsVisionEncoding):
336            self._encoder_cache = VisionEncoderCache[TextAndVisionContext](
337                plan=memory_plan.vision_cache_plan,
338                devices=self._devices,
339            )
340
341        # Device the sampler runs on. ``sample_on_host`` routes sampling to the
342        # host CPU.
343        self._sampler_device: Device = (
344            CPU()
345            if pipeline_config.sampling.sample_on_host
346            else self._devices[0]
347        )
348        sampler_device_ref = DeviceRef.from_device(self._sampler_device)
349
350        samplers = load_sampler_graphs(
351            session, pipeline_config, sampler_device_ref, self.vocab_size
352        )
353        bitmask_sampler = samplers.get(GraphRole.SAMPLER_BITMASK)
354        self._sampler_with_bitmask: Model | None = (
355            bitmask_sampler.engine_model if bitmask_sampler else None
356        )
357        self._sampler_without_bitmask: Model | None = samplers[
358            GraphRole.SAMPLER
359        ].engine_model
360        self.compiled_modules = {
361            **self._pipeline_model.compiled_modules,
362            **samplers,
363        }
364
365        # Pre-allocate pinned buffer for D2H token copies only when the
366        # bitmask path is wired in. This buffer is used for async token
367        # transfers in the guided decoding path. Allocated once and reused
368        # across batches. Skip in virtual device mode (compile-only) since
369        # VirtualDevice does not support memory allocation.
370        self._pinned_new_tokens: Buffer | None = None
371        if (
372            pipeline_config.needs_bitmask_constraints
373            and not self._sampler_device.is_host
374            and not is_virtual_device_mode()
375        ):
376            self._pinned_new_tokens = Buffer(
377                shape=(max_batch_size,),
378                dtype=DType.int64,
379                device=self._sampler_device,
380                usage=Usage.STAGING | Usage.UNTRACKED,
381            )
382
383        self._identity_logit_offsets = (
384            FusedSamplingProcessor.allocate_identity_logit_offsets(
385                pipeline_config, self._sampler_device, max_batch_size
386            )
387        )

QnA 1.1.6.1.7 · What exactly is in the returned MemoryPlan?All seven dataclass fields, their consumers and a complete example objectSOURCE + EXAMPLE
FieldWhat the value meansBaseline exampleConsumer

Complete baseline example · illustrative values

This is a JSON-shaped view of the frozen dataclass. In Python, device_specs is a tuple of DeviceSpec objects and null values below correspond to None.

{
  "planned_max_batch_size": 4,
  "footprint": 22133919728,
  "planned_max_length": 4096,
  "available_cache_memory": 8657043456,
  "device_specs": [
    {
      "device_type": "gpu",
      "id": 0
    }
  ],
  "planned_max_batch_total_tokens": null,
  "vision_cache_plan": null
}

The baseline uses four 4096-token contexts, page size 128, two-byte unquantized KV elements, one device, no draft/vision reservation and a non-binding allocation cap. It is a calculation, not a captured runtime object.

Limits of footprint and special branches

For the ordinary baseline, footprint = weights + activation reserve + signals + vision reserve + cache budget. In the optional OOM search branch, this revision recalculates total_size as model_weights_size + actual_kv_cache_size, while keeping the earlier committed cache field. The full source is retained so these details remain visible.

Virtual-device cross-compilation bypasses device-memory fitting and returns a synthetic 1 TiB cache budget. A multi-component pipeline without a "main" model takes another path with no language-model KV plan. Those branches are outside the standard Llama exercise. Failure to query device statistics is propagated for KV models.

87@dataclass(frozen=True)
88class MemoryPlan:
89    """The memory plan computed when a pipeline is loaded.
90
91    Carries the effective batch size, sequence-length bound, and memory
92    budgets that the pipeline and its schedulers consume. Produced by
93    :meth:`MemoryEstimator.plan`.
94    """
95
96    planned_max_batch_size: int
97    """The maximum number of requests scheduled together in one batch: the
98    user's ``runtime.max_batch_size``, or the value planning inferred when
99    the user left it unset."""
100
101    footprint: int
102    """The estimated total device memory the pipeline uses, in bytes."""
103
104    planned_max_length: int | None
105    """The resolved maximum sequence length after memory planning lowered
106    it to fit device memory: the construction-resolved
107    ``config.model.max_length``, clamped to what the KV cache and any
108    draft model can hold. ``None`` for pipelines with no main language
109    model, such as diffusion pipelines."""
110
111    available_cache_memory: int | None = None
112    """The device memory committed to the KV cache, in bytes. ``None`` when
113    the plan reserves no KV-cache budget, such as for models without a KV
114    cache."""
115
116    device_specs: tuple[DeviceSpec, ...] | None = None
117    """The device specs the plan was computed for, kept as specs rather
118    than ``Device`` objects so the plan can cross process boundaries.
119    ``None`` for plans that never load devices, such as diffusion
120    pipelines."""
121
122    planned_max_batch_total_tokens: int | None = None
123    """Cap on the total context tokens resident across a batch: the user's
124    ``runtime.max_batch_total_tokens``, or ``planned_max_length`` for
125    architectures that require a cap. ``None`` means no cap is configured."""
126
127    vision_cache_plan: VisionCachePlan | None = None
128    """Block-mode vision cache reservation; ``None`` means entry-count mode."""
129
130    def require_device_specs(self) -> tuple[DeviceSpec, ...]:
131        """Returns the device specs, which must be set on this plan.
132
133        Raises:
134            AssertionError: If the plan carries no device specs.
135        """
136        assert self.device_specs is not None, (
137            "memory plan lacks device specs; pipelines require a "
138            "plan built by the registry's memory-planning step"
139        )
140        return self.device_specs
